'''Melikah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the start of the [[Galactic War]]. Part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces that [[Attack on the Fortitude|attacked]] the [[Fortitude (Valor-class)|''Fortitude'']] in [[3642 BBY]]. She fell in battle against the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].

==Powers and abilities==
She was a skilled [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sorcerer, as evidenced by her use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force Lightning]] and [[Force Storm]]. She was also capable of using a dark side type of force heal. With the exception of [[Arrax (Sith)|Arrax]] and [[Tasandra]], she was the strongest Sith in the attack.
